items.title: Jensen Huang says he’d be willing to return to Nvidia, in first remarks since exit
items.description: The company co-founder said in a statement Tuesday that he has received an outpouring of support for his return. Its board said Monday that it was not considering the move.

items.title: Lawmakers set date for Nvidia CEO to testify
items.description: The hearing will allow lawmakers to ask questions of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang in public, in real time.

items.title: U.S. job gains look good — just not for women, analysis finds
items.description: More than 240,000 women age 20 and older have left the labor force since January, while an even greater number of men entered it, the analysis found.
